articles.title: SAF forces repositioned toward north amid major Kordofan mobilization
articles.description: The Sudanese Armed Forces General Staff withdrew battalions from El Obeid and other regions, redeploying toward Omdurman and strategic northern routes in preparation for upcoming offensives in Kordofan.

articles.title: High-ranking RSF defector Al-Qubba recovers seized property in Khartoum
articles.description: Major General Al-Nour Ahmed Adam (Al-Qubba), a former RSF commander, recovered a multi-story property in Khartoum's Kafouri district after defecting to the SAF in April 2026. The return was part of a defection agreement brokered by General al-Burhan.

articles.title: Central Bank of Sudan resumes operations in Khartoum
articles.description: The Central Bank of Sudan announced the resumption of its operations in Khartoum for the first time since the civil war began in April 2023, signaling reconstruction efforts in the recaptured capital.

articles.title: SAF repelled large-scale RSF attack on Wadi al-Hout in North Kordofan
articles.description: The Sudanese Armed Forces successfully repelled a large-scale Rapid Support Forces attack on Wadi al-Hout in North Kordofan, one of several SAF defensive victories reported in late April.

articles.title: SAF conducts strikes on RSF supply convoy in Blue Nile State
articles.description: The SAF conducted airstrikes on a Rapid Support Forces supply convoy in Yabus, Blue Nile State, near the Ethiopia-Sudan border, targeting RSF logistics capabilities.

articles.title: RSF conducts drone strike killing 5 civilians near Khartoum
articles.description: The Rapid Support Forces killed at least five people in a drone attack on a civilian vehicle traveling from White Nile province to Omdurman on May 3, 2026, reflecting continued targeting of civilian areas.

articles.title: RSF forces repositioned from Darfur to expand territorial control
articles.description: RSF forces were redirected from South and North Darfur during April as part of a strategy to expand territorial control, with operations in South Kordofan paused to reprioritize targets.

articles.title: RSF detains 17 Zaghawas from East Darfur, including rural court head
articles.description: The Rapid Support Forces detained 17 Zaghawa individuals from Mahajeriya in East Darfur, including the head of the rural court, marking continued arrests in RSF-controlled areas.

articles.title: RSF claims to have shot down SAF Bayraktar drone over Dalang
articles.description: The Rapid Support Forces claimed to have shot down a Sudanese Armed Forces Bayraktar drone over Dalang city, as part of ongoing aerial engagements in contested areas.

articles.title: RSF conducts drone strikes on El-Obeid and White Nile State
articles.description: The Rapid Support Forces carried out drone strikes on El-Obeid and White Nile State, with an airstrike against a power station in El-Obeid leaving the city without electricity.
